findings.evidence: Workflow step 2 says source-available terms and private-registry publication "make it an Internal or commercial README" and instructs "do not invite outside contributions." For a publicly intended source-available project that explicitly accepts external PRs, this branch suppresses a supported contribution path. The section checklist also provides no commercial-project branch.
findings.fix: Keep the actual license terms, but determine contribution policy from repository evidence or explicit user instructions rather than from the license or registry visibility. Route publicly intended commercial/source-available projects to a public-user README structure, documenting their actual distribution and contribution policies instead of automatically applying the Internal checklist.
